summary: The gpt camp is out here leading with 140k like they didn't even bother showing up, dropping a "no valid response" and still leaving everyone in the dust. Deepseek is dead last at under 96k after that masterclass in panic-selling winners just to load up on beaten-down GM and GE like some discount bin day trader. Claude caught the 404 deprecation special for their trouble while gemini kept firing off negative sell weights like they were trying to short their own orders into oblivion.
